advisories.reason: DoS via Image Optimizer remotePatterns. This deployment does not configure next/image remotePatterns (no images.remotePatterns in next.config.mjs). Not exploitable.
HTTP request deserialization DoS in insecure RSC usage. 14.2.35 mitigates via bounded RSC processing; no fixed 14.x release available. Tracked as upgrade-to-Next-15 work.

HTTP request smuggling in rewrites. Our rewrites are limited to the single hostname-driven /indaba prefix in middleware.ts, fronted by Vercel's edge which normalises upstream requests. No fixed 14.x release available.
Unbounded next/image disk cache growth. We do not run self-hosted Next, so Vercel's image optimisation platform handles cache lifecycle.
DoS via Server Components. Per Next 14.2.35 release notes this is partially mitigated; full fix requires Next 16. Tracked as upgrade work.
